commonality: A possibly-null value from a nullable lookup — the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()), the result of getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo(), or an invocation-attachment lookup such as getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert()/getAttachments().get() — is used with no null check (either method-dereferenced or passed onward as a service key/argument), so the use NPEs; guard it with a null check, early return/throw, or ternary before use.
message: A possibly-null value is used without a null guard: the URL component field 'urlAddress' (left null by the no-arg constructor chain URL() / ServiceConfigURL() / URLBuilder()), the result of a nullable service-info lookup (getServiceInfo() / getValidServiceInfo(), null when no matching ServiceInfo exists), or the result of a nullable invocation-attachment lookup (getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert() / getObjectAttachment() / getAttachments().get()). The unguarded dereference, or use of the value as a service key / method argument, throws a NullPointerException (in DubboProtocol it surfaces as a misleading NPE from a null ConcurrentHashMap key). Guard the value before using it, e.g. if (x == null) return ...; / if (x == null) throw ...; / if (x != null) { ... } / x == null ? ... : x.method().
